notes.title: TAPSONIC BOLD - Basic Play Guide
notes.content:
TAPSONIC BOLD is rhythm action game you can enjoy with keyboard.
Press keys at the accurate timing as note comes down on the screen.

Basic keyboard input keys are : S,D,F and J,K,L
l  All the input keys can be changed in SETTINGS.

[b]1. TAP NOTE[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602054/2b538241bd18bf4217000497323b1dfe6e3289a1.gif[/img]

-> When each line's note comes at the judgement spot, input the key.
 
[b]2. LONG NOTE & SLIDE NOTE[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602054/535e3519c330f3b3db943f10ab90ef9f47850464.gif[/img]

[b]LONG NOTE[/b]
-> When each line's note comes at the judgement spot, input the key and holds until the note ends.

[b]SLIDE NOTE[/b]
-> Same input system as LONG NOTE, but change the line as the note's connecting spot and keep input if needed.

[b]3. LINE CHANGE NOTE[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33602054/15fef716b6c29cad87f1260651e853bfe2ff21f2.gif[/img]

-> There's 2 types of line change.  If you process line change notes, number of lines will change.

-> Press S,D,K,L key at the same time when yellow arrow note gets on the judgement point.

-> Press D,F,J,K key at the same time when red arrow note gets on the judgement point.

[b]※   At first, we recommend pressing all the input keys (S,D,F or J,K,L).[/b]
[b]※   You can select auto-line change for line changing note in settings.[/b]
